Statement: The units reported for a transaction are within the policy tolerance of a committed meter log: |reported_units - logged_units| * 10000 <= logged_units * max_discrepancy_bps.

max_discrepancy_bps.description: Allowed discrepancy in basis points. The verifier refuses a proof whose tolerance is looser than the registry policy.

transaction_ref.description: Non-zero reference to the transaction the usage belongs to.

reported_units.description: The units the agent reports, for example shots or QPU seconds.

logged_units.description: The units in the meter log.

salt.description: Random blinding value for the log commitment.

log_commitment.description: Poseidon2(DOMAIN, transaction_ref, logged_units, salt). A meter that publishes this when the work runs lets a verifier check the report against it.

Limits: Binds the report to a committed log. The log is only as trustworthy as whoever publishes its commitment, so a verifier should compare log_commitment with one the meter published.
